steps.label: Review: front texture view
criteria: The candidate shows the same robot as the first reference: glossy white armor plates, dark joints, small red accents, a human-like face framed by a robotic head casing, small ear pieces.
The candidate's pose, silhouette, proportions and camera match the second reference (a grey clay render of the 3D model) closely enough to project the candidate onto that model.
Plain light background, no extra objects, no broken or extra fingers, no melted details.
